snippet.title: Lucky Newt (Proto) | Final Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
Join Lucky Newt on a twisting 3D adventure! Use his incredible new powers with just a step of your foot, you can stick to the wall like a magnet to reach new areas and terrible foes like never before! Collect Lucky Charms that power up your enchanted accessory - The Blue Gloves, and stop Salazar's nefarious goals of taking over your home, The Luckypad Lagoon! Lucky Newt (Prototype) is now available for Windows only! 

Get Lucky Newt! https://ethaniyan.gumroad.com/l/luckynewt

Learn more about Lucky Newt! luckynewt.com
